verdict.rationale: The product is itself an AI service, and tasks can be handed to Perplexity-hosted agents. Presets give "a working agent in one field", built-in tools cover web search, URL fetch and a code sandbox, and Computer can browse, run code and create documents. However, all of this is reached programmatically through the API or an MCP integration; nothing shows an assistant built into the product's own console or interface (the Playground is for running searches, not delegating tasks). Missing for 10: an in-product assistant in the console or UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of task delegation.
